newsitem.title: USA: Clinton declares state of emergency in Puerto Rico.
newsitem.headline: Clinton declares state of emergency in Puerto Rico.

text.p: President Bill Clinton declared a state of emergency in Puerto Rico on Thursday, ordering federal aid to supplement local recovery efforts after 20 people were killed and at least 80 injured in the collapse of an apartment building.
The White House said in a written statement that Clinton's action authorised the Federal Emergency Management Agency "to activate and deploy" rescue teams to Puerto Rico.

Five floors of apartments and offices collapsed on a shoe store on the ground floor of the building in the busy Rio Piedras commercial district of San Juan, burying victims under metal beams and broken concrete.
Officials said there was reason to believe a massive natural gas explosion shoe store set off the collapse.
